Note on Promoter & Promoter Group Holding {A1(d)}: Docon Technologies Private Limited (“Docon”), an erstwhile Promoter of Thyrocare Technologies Limited (“Company”), was amalgamated with API Holdings Limited (“API”), a member of the Promoter Group, pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation ("Scheme") sanctioned by the Hon’ble NCLT, Mumbai Bench. The Scheme became effective on September 03, 2026 upon filing of the NCLT order with the RoC.

Consequently, Docon ceased to exist and its entire shareholding of 8,12,00,000 equity shares (51.02%) in the Company stood transferred to and vested in API by operation of law, with no change in the aggregate shareholding of the Promoter and Promoter Group.

Further the requisite disclosures were made by the Company, API (Promoter Group) and Docon (erstwhile Promoter) with the Stock Exchanges and SEBI (as may be applicable) under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR and Regulations 10(6), 10(7), 29 and 31 of the SEBI SAST Regulations.
